items.title: Spectral adapters for liver metastasis segmentation
items.summary: New arXiv preprint introducing DiSECT and SiGA, two parameter-efficient adapters for Segment Anything. Evaluated on 446 CT volumes, SiGA achieved 0.77 Dice with a single-point prompt. Preprint; not peer reviewed.

items.title: Multimodal risk prediction in Scientific Reports
items.summary: My co-first-author study combines clinical and CT-derived imaging data for preoperative risk prediction in colorectal liver metastases.

items.title: Grad Chat: medical imaging and liver cancer AI
items.summary: My interview on liver tumour segmentation, tumour-type classification, and survival prediction was reshared by Queen’s SGSPA and the Centre for Health Innovation on LinkedIn.
